{{Top|leg}}
[[Information retrieval droid]]s were a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used as automated infochants. One such droid was responsible for providing information to new arrivals to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It gave [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] information about [[Coruscant City Tours]].
